1. Hetal Parekh a young 18 year old school-goingirl was raped and murdered on March 5, 1990 between 5.30 and 5.45 p.m. in her Flat No. 3-A, on the third floor of 'Anand Apartment'. The appellant was challenged and tried for rape and murder and also for an offence under Section 380 IPC for committing theft of a wrist-watch from the said flat. facts: Hetal Parekh, a young 18-year-old school-going girl, was raped and murdered on March 5, 1990.
The appellant, Dhananjoy Chatterjee Dhana, was challenged and tried for rape and murder, as well as theft of a wrist-watch from the flat.

The learned Additional Sessions Judge found him guilty and convicted the appellant (i) for an offence under Section 302 IPC and sentenced him to death, (ii) for an offence under Section 376 IPC and sentenced him to imprisonment for life, and (iii) for the offence under Section 380 IPC, he was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for five years.

The substantive sentences under Sections 376 and 380 IPC were ordered to run concurrently but were to cease to have any effect, in case the sentence of death for conviction of the appellant under Section 302 IPC was confirmed by the High Court and the appellant was executed.
issues: Whether the appellant committed the crime of rape and murder
Whether the evidence against the appellant is sufficient to prove his guilt beyond a reasonable doubt
petitioner_arguments: The appellant pleaded innocence and alleged false implication 'due to quarrel with PW 4 over his transfer'
He denied the recoveries allegedly made from him
respondent_arguments: The prosecution case was that the appellant had been teasing Hetal Parekh on her way to and back from school, and had proposed to her on March 2, 1990
The prosecution argued that the evidence against the appellant is sufficient to prove his guilt beyond a reasonable doubt
court_reasoning: The court held that the entire case rests on circumstantial evidence
The court noted that there was no eyewitness of this occurrence and that the medical witness found as many as 21 injuries on the deceased
holding: The Supreme Court confirmed the death sentence imposed by the High Court
